# Coverage-only completion record

This record concerns source and variant coverage only. The skill's executable helper, output template, plugin registration, package and evaluation results were not changed or revalidated in this pass.

The ledger accounts for 519 variant records and 442 method sources after explicit alias consolidation.

| Status | Records |
| --- | ---: |
| blocked_unverified | 5 |
| conditional_method | 245 |
| delegated | 54 |
| excluded_with_reason | 21 |
| integrated | 18 |

`integrated` means used by the shared core or its authoring structure; `conditional_method` means selectable only for its documented gap; `delegated` identifies a concrete acquisition route; `specialist_only` preserves a method in its own domain/lifecycle; `excluded_with_reason` records a deliberate incompatibility; `blocked_unverified` means the underlying evidence could not be established and no coverage claim is made.
